[Section] Discussion ::: Overcoming the cross-lingual gap is not what makes Translate-Train work.
[source_id=55] The original motivation for Translate-Train was to train the model on the same language it is tested on. However, we show that it is training on translated data, rather than training on the target language, that is key for this approach to outperform Zero-Shot as reported by previous authors.
